issue.body:
- Fix caching of opaque responses in data groups with `freshness` strategy.
- Clean-up/Simplify `service-worker` tests.

(See individual commits for details.)

Fixes #30968.

body:
You are right, @borjapazr. It looks like a bug in the [`if` condition][1] (since `okToCacheOpaque` is never taken into account atm, because opaque responses have `res.ok === false`). I assume the intention was to negate the condition:

```diff
-if (!res.ok || (okToCacheOpaque && res.type === 'opaque')) {
+if (!(res.ok || (okToCacheOpaque && res.type === 'opaque'))) {
```

I have a fix for that in #30977 (see https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/30977/commits/7352a7fd8fbf6e0b5273740207af98e337ebb409), but we should also add some docs about this (e.g. similar to [workbox's][2]).

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8c4bd61b2fe849aa44a50f4db3f1c81c42541b54/packages/service-worker/worker/src/data.ts#L486
[2]: https://developers.google.com/web/tools/workbox/guides/handle-third-party-requests
@gkalpak that change looks right to me.

> You are right, @borjapazr. It looks like a bug in the [`if` condition](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8c4bd61b2fe849aa44a50f4db3f1c81c42541b54/packages/service-worker/worker/src/data.ts#L486) (since `okToCacheOpaque` is never taken into account atm, because opaque responses have `res.ok === false`). I assume the intention was to negate the condition:
> 
> ```diff
> -if (!res.ok || (okToCacheOpaque && res.type === 'opaque')) {
> +if (!(res.ok || (okToCacheOpaque && res.type === 'opaque'))) {
> ```
> 
> I have a fix for that in #30977 (see [7352a7f](https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/7352a7fd8fbf6e0b5273740207af98e337ebb409)), but we should also add some docs about this (e.g. similar to [workbox's](https://developers.google.com/web/tools/workbox/guides/handle-third-party-requests)).

Now it makes sense to me. Thank you @gkalpak.

And adding more documentation would be a great idea 😊

issue.body: I was looking for v8.1.0 changelog, and realized that I need to read all pre-release versions in order to know what's changed. See the changes on changelog.md: > > # [8.1.0](https://github.com/angular/angular/compare/8.1.0-rc.0...8.1.0) (2019-07-02) > > > ### Bug Fixes > > * **core:** handle `undefined` meta in `injectArgs` ([#31333](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/31333)) ([80ccd6c](https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/80ccd6c)), closes [CLI #14888](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/issues/14888) > * **service-worker:** cache opaque responses in data groups with `freshness` strategy ([#30977](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/30977)) ([b0c3453](https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/b0c3453)), closes [#30968](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/30968) > * **service-worker:** cache opaque responses when requests exceeds timeout threshold ([#30977](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/30977)) ([a9038ef](https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/a9038ef)) > Reading the other releases, there was many, many other changes on this release that are not on changelog of the version itself, but on `.rc*`, `.next-*`... Shouldn't the changelog be a merge of all pre-release versions?
